description: This file defines the ClaimExpenseAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing claim expenses within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting claim expense records, along with associated validation rules and annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for handling claim expense operations such as listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting expenses associated with claims within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all claim expenses for a specific request, including sorting, pagination, and total calculations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new claim expense, initializing a new ClaimExpense object and setting its properties.

methods.name: setClaimExpense
methods.description: Populates a ClaimExpense object with data from request parameters, including validation and saving to the database.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for request parameters of the getAll method.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more claim expenses associated with a specific request ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific claim expense by its ID within a claim request, with validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for parameters of the getOne method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing claim expense with new data from the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update method parameters.
